cases.title: Business growth review
cover: A practical review of customer value, reach and results.
text: Use interviews and small pilots to test a real need before offering the same solution to more teams.
Connect the product, onboarding and customer success so each new project builds on a repeatable method.
cases.listSummary: Focus on proven needs and repeatable value.
items: Learn why customers buy and when they would use it again.
Help new users finish a useful task and see value sooner.
Turn proven delivery examples into reusable sales material.
image: Start with a clear use case, then make onboarding repeatable.
Keep the design familiar so the team can focus on decisions.
chartText: Demo data: new clients rise from 12 to 36 across four quarters.
closing: Build on what works. All content and data are fictional.

cases.title: Operational efficiency plan
cover: A plan for clearer ownership and smoother delivery.
text: Define the input, owner and acceptance criteria for key steps so the team spends less time asking again.
Capture common decisions in a shared playbook, then use feedback from each delivery to improve it.
cases.listSummary: Turn process goals into clear team actions.
items: Collect requests in one place with clear acceptance rules.
Assign an owner at each handoff to cut waiting and rework.
Reuse tested material and steps for recurring deliverables.
Share task status and risks early so others can prepare.
Find the next bottleneck and make each lesson reusable.
image: Give every handoff clear inputs, an owner and a shared definition of done.
Capture what works so new team members can deliver with less rework.
chartText: Demo data: the average delivery cycle falls from 32 to 16 days.
closing: Make every handoff clearer. All content and data are fictional.
